# Claude Code 2.1.326 model picker

Captured from the npm-published CLI on macOS on 2026-11-17 at 189×48. The
private test configuration was seeded with the account model catalog; opening
and cancelling the picker submitted no model turn. The surrounding session
banner and scratch-directory path were removed.

This version combines the selectable `More models` disclosure with the effort
adjustment hint on the effort row. Claude 2.1.327 moves that hint to the footer.
